sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the complete DIRECT_CALCULATION contract: correct longitudinal-frame targeting, applicability evidence, exclusive m alternatives with inclusive m=13.3 and m<13.3 comparisons, declared operands and results, canonical datatypes and units, and two-sided tolerances scaled from each expected formula result. Deterministic validation is valid.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the applicability alternatives allow significantlyDifferentBoundaryConditions=true to pass with any frameMomentFactorM, including 13.3 or a larger value, despite the requirement requiring a smaller factor when boundary conditions are significantly different. Add a direct comparison enforcing frameMomentFactorM < 13.3 in that branch (and ensure the branch-selection evidence cannot be absent), while retaining the exact inclusive 13.3 bounds for the non-different continuous-beam case.

Replace the formula query's non-permitted ABS() calls with supported arithmetic and simple piecewise logic (or equivalent two-sided tolerance comparisons) using tolerance scaled from each expected result. Also encode the non-different continuous-beam m=13.3 branch with equal inclusive bounds (sh:minInclusive and sh:maxInclusive both 13.3, or an equivalent bounded conditional constraint), while retaining the existing explicit m < 13.3 check when significantlyDifferentBoundaryConditions is true. All prior branch-selection requirements remain applicable.

Reject: the calculation query computes section modulus Z with the constant 13.3 instead of the declared frameMomentFactorM. Retrieve the frameMomentFactorM numeric value as ?m and use ?m in the Z denominator, so the significantly-different-boundary branch with m < 13.3 affects the derived result. Preserve the existing two-sided expected-result tolerances and both explicit applicability branches, including required branch-selection evidence and inclusive m = 13.3 bounds for the non-different continuous-beam case.

Candidate faithfully encodes the complete DIRECT_CALCULATION contract: correct longitudinal-frame targeting, applicability evidence, exclusive m alternatives with inclusive m=13.3 and m<13.3 comparisons, declared operands and results, canonical datatypes and units, and two-sided tolerances scaled from each expected formula result. Deterministic validation is valid.
